not_evaluable.NL: energy_load is net of behind-the-meter solar (midday trough falls to 0.17x the country median and deepens Jan->Aug with the solar year); the TSO day-ahead forecast, our ML forecast and the D-7 baseline all sit ~9-10 GW through that trough. Truth and forecasts are on different bases, so no arm is measurable against it.
